_doc: CANONICAL write-saturation benchmark for durable-streams (see AGENTS.md 'Canonical suites'). Two configs on ONE cluster: wal-ideal = the validated ideal disk configuration (WAL_TUNING.md: 3 stream lanes + 3 WAL shard lanes on 6 raw-block NVMe devices, syncfs checkpoints [unconditional on Linux], 1GiB retained-WAL checkpoint budget + 60s fallback, exclusive pinned cores) and memory = the no-fsync ceiling. References (2026-07-13): wal-ideal 374k @100k (no cliff: -3% vs 10k... 385k @10k), memory 512k @100k (-6% vs 10k). REGRESSION GATE: wal-ideal@100k < 250k or memory@100k < 400k or a >30% 10k->100k drop = cliff regression -> stop, diagnose, fix. RUN WITH: DS_TARGET=remote STATIC_CPU=1 SPLITLANE=1 GUARANTEED=1 SERVER_LOCAL_SSD_BLOCK=1 SERVER_MANIFEST=gke/durable-streams-splitlane3x3-guaranteed.yaml SPOT_SERVER=1. NOTE: memory arm passes --tier off (the manifest bakes in --tier s3 and the server refuses memory+tier).
